name: Bâan: Rinrada's Mystical Departure
source: Rinrada's Mystical Departure is an indie fan game based in the world of Bâan, exploring Rinrada's childhood! Venture out into the land of Euthania with a unique Turn-based RPG combat system, a gripping story and an emotional soundtrack.
